files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run


def test_example():
    r = run({'folder': 'novak_trading'})
    assert r['source_rows_total'] == 216
    assert len(r['category_totals']) == 4
    assert len(r['monthly_totals']) == 9
    assert r['best_month']['revenue_czk'] >= r['worst_month']['revenue_czk']


def test_filters(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'f'
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'sales_2026.csv').write_text('month,customer,category,units,revenue_czk\n2026-01,A,paper,1,"1 000,50"\n2026-02,A,paper,2,300\n2026-02,B,toner,x,5\n2026-03,A,toner,1,50\n', encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'category_filter': 'paper'})
    assert r['best_month']['month'] == '2026-01'
    assert r['best_month']['revenue_czk'] == 1000.5
    assert len(r['skipped_rows']) == 1
    r = run({'folder': 'f', 'from_month': '2026-02', 'to_month': '2026-02'})
    assert len(r['monthly_totals']) == 1


def test_bad_input():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'novak_trading', 'from_month': 'bad'})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nope_missing'})
